madrid-central-spain-alto-tajo-gorge-rid.slogan: A 349 km loop out of Alto Tajo Gorge Ride
madrid-central-spain-alto-tajo-gorge-rid.story: A rider’s loop: clean exit, memorable middle, calm return. A 349 km loop that starts and ends near Arroyomolinos, about 7 h 15 of riding. It goes by way of Boadilla del Monte, Scenic stretch near Colmenar Viejo and near Venturada. The climb of the day is near Navalcarnero. It tops out at about 1,150 m.

madrid-central-spain-alto-tajo-gorge-rid.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: This High point near Navalcarnero → Near Boadilla del Monte stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Scenic stretch near Colmenar Viejo → Photo stop near Venturada is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

sections.to: Brea de Tajo, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop near Venturada → Brea de Tajo, on the way back can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

scenicChapters.title: 18th-Century Royal Palace at Caserta with  → Historic Centre of Naples
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
